1.text: You began your journey at the entrance of some type of fortification. The sky was filled with a redish brown glow and smoke from some not to distant fire. You ventured forward.

choices.text: Before you had the chance to get your grounding you were confronted with a choice. Nothing drew you to either direction but you instinctually chose left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: Before you had the chance to get your grounding you were confronted with a choice. Nothing drew you to either direction but you instinctually chose right.
choices.label: Continue this way

3.text: As you turned the corner nothing of your next steps were revealed. Just a bending paths of wood and debris stood in front of you. You wondered how you could feel lost before the journey had even really begun. Despite this you pushed forward.

4.text: This direction was shadowed by trees and smoke. Nothing was clear in what was ahead aside from yet another turn. Regardless of the lack of visibility you moved forward.

5.text: With the smoke in the air thickening you turned the corner and saw nothing but a lone barrel at the end of the path. You location was confusing to you but these hints of what this place was were building up.

choices.text: Your next choice was infront of you. A clean simple path to the left or wading through the clutter to your right. You chose the simpler path.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: Your next choice was infront of you. A clean simple path to the left or wading through the clutter to your right. You chose the cluttered path.
choices.label: Continue this way

7.text: The walls here were crooked and the air was thicker. A hesitation in this path slowed you down. To continue forward was to trust in where the jouney was taking you.

8.text: Although hesitating you knew your journey was taking you in this direction for a reason so you could do nothing but confidently continue forward.

9.text: Yet another turn and yet another indescript path forward. The turns felt monotonous and you hoped something soon changed is not for your ease but for your sanity.

10.text: As you continued forward your hopes of something new felt met. A change in the journey was ahead, something seemingly less claustrophobic where the smoke eased and the path widened.

11.text: You approached an opening filed with tires, barrels and crates. It seemed to have endless possiblities of where to go. You pushed forward hopeing to find some hint of direction in where to go.

choices.text: A push forward definitivly narrowed down where your journey would take you. You had two options and you felt overwhelmingly confident in which one to take. You pushed forward.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: A push forward definitivly narrowed down where your journey would take you. You had two options and you felt overwhelmingly confident in which one to take. You turned the corner.
choices.label: Continue this way

13.text: This path forward felt right. The smoke had eased and a breeze came. A warm comforting heat surrounded you as you continued.

14.text: Another choice seemed to confront you but as a gust of wind approached from the left you knew that was where you had to go. You pushed on.

15.text: This had led you to an open trapdoor leading into pitch blackness. It seemed as if all paths led here so you were confident in this being the journeys conclusion. You climbed in without a doubt or hesitation.

16.text: Having turned the corner your way is lit and the decay of this place became obvious. Broken walls and rotting sandbags sit before you. You hoped the path was still navigable despite its ruin.

17.text: You approached another corner and as you did the smoke felt thicker. You had doubts for you safety but regarless you contiued forward.

choices.text: You approached another choice. Neither path deterred you but something told you the path to the left was where you needed to go. You followed this instinct.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You approached another choice. Neither path deterred you but something told you the path to the right was where you needed to go. You followed this instinct.
choices.label: Continue this way

19.text: This path was strangely long, empty and straight. Its simplness was uncanny but you pushed forward anyway listening out for any sign of further decay.

20.text: Continuing forward the once seemingly simple path revealed openings which inevitibly would give you another decision to make.

choices.text: Your decision was ahead of you. The broken, decaying path to the left or the straight, simply path forward. You confidently chose left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: Your decision was ahead of you. The broken, decaying path to the left or the straight, simply path forward. You confidently chose right.
choices.label: Continue this way

22.text: The path was twisted and tighter than the rest. You squeezed through with hesitation and doubt flowing within you.

23.text: As you squeezed through the tight path became a large opening which gave you time to breath as the smoke was thinner here.

24.text: The opening gave you too many paths you could take so you pushed forward hoping this would narrow down your options.

25.text: As you pushed forward the long path became a sharp corner. A corner you had no option but to take. Although your decisions restricted a confidence in taking this path filled you.

26.text: One corner became another and with this you were certain you were nearly there. This corner felt like the last so without hesitation you zipped around it.

27.text: As you turned the corner you felt defeat. The path seemed to lead to nothing. However before you turned around you noticed something on the ground. You approached with one final glimpse of hope that it would be something..

28.text: As you pushed forward the path ahead seemed collapsed. You felt you had to commit to your decision so you pushed forward anyway but with wariness in ever step.

29.text: Although decayed the path actually seemed navigable. You shuffled forward carefully as not to cause further collapse.

30.text: The thinner the path seemed to get the thicker the smoke and the tighter your chest. It was yet to be unbarable so you felt confident your journey could continue and you reach you goal.

31.text: As you squeezed forward the path led to a corner. You hoped that turning this corner would lead to a path that would be a lot easier than it has been.

32.text: The corner turned into another but with this one came a choice ahead of you. You pushed forward unsure of which turn you would make.

choices.text: This choice was between design and instinct. Left was a small gap you could squeeze through and felt the desire to do so. Forward was the direction this path was intended to take you. You chose left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: This choice was between design and instinct. Left was a small gap you could squeeze through and felt the desire to do so. Forward was the direction this path was intended to take you. You chose forward.
choices.label: Continue this way

34.text: Thankfully the path widened and you continued forward. The smoke lessened and you felt a confidence you had nearly completed your journey and therefore swiftly pushed forward.

35.text: Another choice seemed to confront you but as a gust of wind flowed from the right you felt that was a sign in where you were to go.

36.text: Another choice seemed to confront you but as a gust of wind approached from the path forward you felt that was a sign in where you were to go.
